name: How much does it cost to move a shower drain?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to move a shower drain when changing the bathroom layout?
mainEntity.text: How much does it cost to move a shower drain when changing the bathroom layout?

acceptedAnswer.text: Relocating a shower drain is often one of the more expensive parts of a bathroom layout change because it affects plumbing, subfloor or slab work, waterproofing, and tile reconstruction. The simpler the access under the bathroom, the easier the move tends to be. In slab-on-grade homes, the drain change can become much more involved because concrete cutting and patching may be required. This is why two bathrooms of the same size can have very different budgets depending on the structure below them. Homeowners should ask for a separate line item for drain relocation so they can compare alternate layouts. Sometimes keeping the shower close to the original plumbing path produces the best mix of function and cost.
acceptedAnswer.description: Moving a shower drain adds cost because it requires plumbing relocation, waterproofing adjustments, and floor repair. The price rises sharply if the home is on a slab foundation, where cutting and patching concrete may be necessary.
